# sapintegrationsuite_oauth2_client_credential (Data Source)

Reads an existing Security Content "OAuth2 Client Credentials" artifact by its name. Never returns the client secret: SAP's Security Content API does not document returning a stored credential's secret, and this data source has no field for one even if it did.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sapintegrationsuite_oauth2_client_credential" "backend" {
  id = "BACKEND_OAUTH"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The credential artifact's name (its OData key and adapter alias).

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) The OAuth2 client ID registered with the token service.
- `description` (String) The credential artifact's free-text description.
- `scope` (String) OAuth2 scope requested, if the token service requires one.
- `token_service_url` (String) URL of the OAuth2 authorization server that issues the access token.
